title: UAAP: Ateneo coach Louie Alas gets one-game suspension

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo will have to play without its coach, Louie Alas when it faces Far Eastern University in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday after the league handed him a one-game suspension. The league announced the penalty Friday after Alas accumulated three technical fouls for the season, including two in the Blue Eagles’ 83-76 loss to rival La Salle last Wednesday.
